map.小麦机收亩耗油约 1.2 L/亩，作业 500 亩则油耗 = 500 × 1.2: Wheat machine harvest fuel about 1.2 L/mu; 500 mu gives 500 x 1.2 = 600 L. At 7.5 yuan/L, fuel cost 4500 yuan, 12.5% of the harvest fee (about 60 yuan/mu).
map.为什么不同作业亩耗油差很多？: Why does fuel per mu vary so much by operation?
map.耕深、阻力、车速决定负荷。深松/旋耕最费油，运输较轻。同一机型负荷越大单位油耗越: Till depth, resistance, and speed set the load. Subsoiling/rotary tillage use the most, transport the least. For the same model, higher load raises per-unit fuel but also efficiency; look at "mu" not "hours".
map.怎么降低亩耗油？: How to lower fuel per mu?
map.保持机具锐利、胎压正常、档位转速匹配（避免大油门低速）、合理规划减少空驶。定期保: Keep tools sharp, tire pressure normal, gear-RPM matched (avoid high throttle at low speed), and plan to cut empty runs. Regular maintenance saves more fuel than a bigger engine.
